title: Outdoor Grilled Uruguayan Ovoli Mushroom Wrap
description: This dish features ovoli mushrooms and macrobiotic friendly ingredients, all wrapped in a ti leaf wrap, inspired by Uruguayan cuisine
instructions: Preheat the grill to medium high heat, about 400 degrees Fahrenheit.
In a bowl, mix together the sliced ovoli mushrooms, grilled onions, and grilled bell peppers.
Add the fried rice to the bowl and stir until everything is well combined.
Lay a ti leaf flat on a surface and spoon about 1/2 cup of the mushroom and rice mixture onto the center of the leaf.
Sprinkle some uruguayan cheese on top of the filling and drizzle with chimichurri sauce.
Fold the ti leaf over the filling to form a wrap, and repeat with the remaining ingredients.
Place the wraps on the grill and cook for about 2-3 minutes on each side, until the ti leaves are slightly charred.
Serve the wraps hot, garnished with additional chimichurri sauce if desired.
